note: Set A is more concise and usable, though it hallucinates specific conditions like 'Detail A5' and 'Structure South Elevation' which are not in the text. Set B captures the single heavy hex nut missed by A but suffers from excessive duplicates (e.g., bolts extracted three times, HSS twice) and vague, trivial dimension claims with invented conditions ('vertical offset').
remarks: Both sets misidentify 3/8" plate thickness as weld size. Set B's high duplication rate significantly reduces its utility despite higher recall on some items.
